GUANYU.name: Guan Yu (the red whole-face, zheng lian)
GUANYU.pattern: the whole face one field of deep cinnabar red. Long black 'sleeping silkworm' eyebrows, thick and gently arched, rising toward the temples. Long narrow black 'phoenix' eye sockets slanting up to the temples, the eyes inside narrow with small white. A slim black nose socket around the nostrils. A few fine black lines: one short vertical crease between the brows and thin curved lines under the eyes. One small black mole dot beside the nose bridge. The mouth plain, closed, drawn in thin black line. No white areas except inside the eyes.

CAOCAO.name: Cao Cao (the water-white whole-face, shui bai lian)
CAOCAO.pattern: the whole face one field of matte chalk white ('water white'), slightly cool against the cream paper. Long thin black eyebrows, slightly knotted, rising toward the temples. Long narrow black eye outlines drawn as slim triangles that taper out toward the temples, the eyes inside narrow and sly. Between the brows (the yintang) a small soft flesh-pink patch with ONE fine curved black stroke in it. Fine thin black wrinkle lines fanning from the outer corners of both eyes, fine curved lines along both nose-to-mouth folds and at the corners of the mouth, a few short frown creases. Everything symmetrical. NO mole, no single dot, no other colour: white, thin black line, and the small pink yintang patch only; the lines are few and delicate.

ZHANGFEI.name: Zhang Fei (the black cross-gate 'butterfly' face, hei shizimen)
ZHANGFEI.pattern: white ground. A broad black pillar runs unbroken from the hairline straight down the middle of the forehead and the nose bridge to just below the nose tip. It is crossed by two large black eye sockets shaped like butterfly wings, their outer tails tipping upward to the temples: a laughing face. Above them short black brows shaped like small bats, curling up at the outer ends, and a small red dot under each brow. From the nostrils two broad black bands sweep down and outward around the mouth to the corners of the jaw, framing a small red mouth; below the mouth a white chin with two small black dots. The cheeks tinted soft pink. Merry, rough, laughing: black, white, pink and a little red only.

BAOZHENG.name: Bao Zheng (the black whole-face, hei zheng lian)
BAOZHENG.pattern: the whole face one field of deep matte black. On the middle of the forehead a clear white crescent moon, lying with its horns pointing upward. Two large white eyebrows, broad, knitted toward the centre in a worried frown, with curled inner ends. Thin white rims around the eyes. The cheeks faintly rubbed with a dull red-bronze under the black. Nothing else: black, the white crescent, the white brows.

DIANWEI.name: Dian Wei (the yellow flowered three-tile face, huang hua san kuai wa)
DIANWEI.pattern: ground of warm ochre yellow in three 'tiles': the forehead and the two cheeks, separated by large black eye sockets and a black nose socket. The eyebrows are broad white shapes edged in black, and inside each white brow is drawn a small black halberd (a short pole weapon with a crescent side-blade), pointing outward and up: his pair of halberds. Black pointed eye sockets slanting up; a black nose socket with flared wings; a few black curling lines on the cheeks; a thin red line down the centre of the forehead. Fierce and bold.

XUYANZHAO.name: Xu Yanzhao (the purple six-tenths face, zi liu fen lian, an old loyal minister)
XUYANZHAO.pattern: a six-tenths face. The lower face (cheeks, nose, chin) one field of deep reddish opera purple: a dark maroon-aubergine between black and red, NOT lilac, NOT violet. The whole forehead up to the hairline is taken by two very large white old man's eyebrows shaded with soft grey strokes, and between them a tapering vertical pillar of the same deep purple running from the hairline down to the nose bridge. At the inner head of each white brow, beside the pillar, one small oval black dot. The eyes simply outlined in black with slightly drooping outer corners (no heavy black wings), faint fine wrinkle lines, plain closed mouth. Dignified, old, loyal.

HUANGGAI.name: Huang Gai (the old-red six-tenths face, lao hong liu fen lian, an old loyal general)
HUANGGAI.pattern: a six-tenths face. The lower face (cheeks, nose, chin) one field of saturated deep oil red (a full warm red, NOT pink, NOT salmon). The whole forehead up to the hairline is taken by two very large white old man's eyebrows shaded with grey strokes, and between them a tapering vertical pillar of the same red from the hairline down to the nose bridge. At the inner head of each white brow one small round black dot. The eyes outlined in black with down-turned outer corners, fine black wrinkle lines at the eyes, plain closed mouth. Old, loyal, steadfast general.

CHENGYAOJIN.name: Cheng Yaojin (the green fragmented face, lv sui lian)
CHENGYAOJIN.pattern: ground of mid green, broken into many small fields by patterning: black eye sockets with curling tails, white brows broken into two or three curled lobes edged in black, a white and black patterned nose socket, small red accents at the brow centre and beside the nostrils, curling black and white scroll lines on the cheeks and forehead. Symmetrical, busy, comic and impetuous rather than fierce. Green dominant; white, black and a little red.

JIANGWEI.name: Jiang Wei (the red three-tile face, hong san kuai wa)
JIANGWEI.pattern: a red three-tile face: ground of cinnabar red, divided into three red 'tiles' (the forehead and the two cheeks) by two large black wedge-shaped eye-and-brow blocks that sweep diagonally up from the inner eyes to the temples, each edged with a thin white line, with a slim white brow stripe along the top edge of each block. In the centre of the forehead a round black-and-white taiji (yin-yang) disc, clearly drawn. The nose red, with thin black nostril outlines only (no black blobs). From each nostril wing a black band curves down past the corners of the mouth to the jaw (the mouth fork). Plain closed mouth.

DOUERDUN.name: Dou Erdun (the blue flowered three-tile face, lan hua san kuai wa)
DOUERDUN.pattern: ground of strong blue in three tiles: the forehead and both cheeks. The brow area is his emblem: on each side a brow patch with a red ground on which a yellow hooked weapon shape (the 'tiger-head hook', a blade with a curled hook at the tip) is drawn, edged in black and white, sweeping up to the temple. Semi-circular black eye sockets beneath, edged with a white line. A white and black nose socket with flared wings; a white line pattern at the centre of the forehead; black curling lines on the blue cheeks. Bold, staunch, fierce.

GAODENG.name: Gao Deng (the oil-white three-tile face, you bai san kuai wa)
GAODENG.pattern: ground of white with a slightly shiny, creamy 'oil white' in three tiles: forehead and both cheeks. Black pointed brows rising steeply, large black eye sockets with sharp upward tails, a black nose socket with flared wings, a few thin black lines at the corners of the mouth. Only white and black. Arrogant, overbearing.

ZHENGEN.name: Zheng En, also called Zheng Ziming (the black crooked face, wai lian)
ZHENGEN.pattern: a deliberately ASYMMETRIC black-and-white face: black ground on forehead and cheeks with white patterning. The two eyes do not match ('male and female eyes'): the left eye socket is large, round and white-rimmed, the right eye socket is small, narrow and set a little lower; the brows also differ, one arched high and one low; the nose socket and the mouth are pulled slightly to one side. On the forehead a small white coiled curling motif. Black, white, a little grey. Rough and blunt, comic-crooked.

LUZHISHEN.name: Lu Zhishen (the white monk face, seng lian)
LUZHISHEN.pattern: ground of white with a faint flesh-pink blush on the cheeks. Kidney-shaped black eye sockets. Black 'mantis' brows: each brow a short thick stroke ending in a hooked barb. A patterned black nose socket with curled wings and a patterned mouth outline. In the centre of the forehead one round red relic disc. A few curved black lines on the cheeks. No hair at all at the top: a shaved monk's head, the cap replaced by a bare shaven crown in a pale grey-blue tone.

TANGQIN.name: Tang Qin (a civil clown, chou, with the square 'tofu block' white patch)
TANGQIN.pattern: an ordinary unpainted warm flesh-coloured face. In the middle of it ONE white patch of chalk-white paint, the square 'tofu block': a soft-cornered square brushed on the skin, covering the bridge of the nose and both eyes, from just under the brows down to the nostrils and sideways to just past the outer corners of the eyes. Inside the white: thin black diamond-shaped (lozenge) eye outlines with small sly black eyes looking sideways, short thin black brow ticks sloping down at the top edge of the patch, a thin black nose outline with two small black nostril pits. NO red dots, NO rouge spots, no other colour on the patch. Outside the patch plain skin only: thin lips in a small sly smile. Sly, ingratiating, comic: the scheming civil clown.

KID.name: a child role (wawa sheng, like the boy Nezha): the face that is NOT painted with a pattern
KID.pattern: a five-year-old child's round, chubby face left unpainted: plain pale powdered skin with a soft rouge-pink blush on the cheeks and around the eyes, natural thin black brows, bright open eyes, small red lips. One small round red dot in the middle of the forehead between the brows. No pattern, no coloured fields, no lines. Instead of the adult black cap: a child's black hair with a short soft fringe across the top of the forehead. Open, lively, sweet.

SHIQIAN.name: Shi Qian (a martial clown, wu chou, with the small date-pit white patch)
SHIQIAN.pattern: an ordinary unpainted flesh-coloured face. ONE large white patch shaped like a kite: its upper point rises to the middle of the forehead, its wide part spans across both eyes almost to the temples, and its lower edge is cut into a row of small sharp points along the upper cheeks, narrowing to a point at the tip of the nose. Inside the white, fine black line work: long sharp eye outlines around both eyes, a narrow black lozenge with a white centre down the bridge of the nose, small black brow flicks at the top, a few short curved black lines at the inner eyes, two small black nostril pits. Outside the patch plain skin, a light rouge on the cheeks, a small closed mouth. Quick, impish, nimble, not fierce: the martial clown.

LIUJIN.name: Liu Jin (the red eunuch face, taijian lian)
LIUJIN.pattern: a eunuch face: the whole face a fleshy rubbed red. In the centre of the forehead one flat round disc of dark maroon-brown (the relic bead), with no bright ring. A dark red patch runs from between the brows down the nose. Short black brows shaped like date pits. The eye sockets broad flat horizontal black blocks, like small cleaver blades, drooping a little at the outer corner. Curved black fat-fold lines on the cheeks and beside the nose. Beardless: a water-chestnut shaped mouth with an exaggerated white lower lip. Smug, pampered, sinister.

ZHOUCANG.name: Zhou Cang (the flowered ingot face, hua yuanbao lian)
ZHOUCANG.pattern: a flowered ingot face. The forehead is a separate field in the shape of a Chinese ingot (a broad boat shape with raised ends) above the brows, coloured pale grey-blue, with a narrow red vertical stripe running down its centre to the brow line. Below it the lower face: black and white curling scroll patterns with dark purple-maroon fields on the cheeks between the scrolls, large black eye sockets rimmed in white, bushy black-and-white brows, a patterned white nose socket, a white mouth and chin area. Rough, loyal, fierce.

ERLANG.name: Erlang Shen, Yang Jian (the gold three-tile god face)
ERLANG.pattern: ground of gold (painted as warm metallic ochre-gold pigment, slightly worn) in three tiles: forehead and both cheeks. Black upward-slanting eye sockets and long black brows sweeping to the temples, a black nose socket. In the centre of the forehead a third eye set VERTICALLY: a small upright almond eye with a black pupil, outlined in black. Calm, august. Gold and black only, with white in the eyes.

JINQIANBAO.name: Jinqian Bao, the Gold-Coin Leopard (a gold pictographic spirit face)
JINQIANBAO.pattern: a gold spirit face. Ground of gold (warm metallic ochre-gold pigment). Painted on the forehead, as stylised face paint (not a naturalistic animal picture): a leopard's head built from the brows and forehead marks - two small eyes, a nose and a small red mouth with fangs, outlined in black and white - worked into the pattern. Below it black fierce eye sockets with long upswept tails edged in white. On EACH cheek ONE large round coin: a black and white ring with a square hole in the centre, no writing. Bold black and white scroll curls on the cheeks and jaw, a black nose socket with flared wings and a wide red mouth with small white fangs. Gold, black, white and a little red.

ZHONGKUI.name: Zhong Kui the demon-queller (the flowered ingot face, hua yuanbao lian)
ZHONGKUI.pattern: the forehead is a separate ingot-shaped field of red, above the brows; in its centre a small gold bat with spread wings. Below, the lower face is black and white with a flattened broad nose: bushy black brows, round black eye sockets rimmed in white, a white patterned nose socket, white curling lines on black cheeks, and a broad laughing mouth. Ugly, kindly, comic-fierce.

XIAHOUDUN.name: Xiahou Dun (the blue three-tile face, lan san kuai wa)
XIAHOUDUN.pattern: ground of blue in three tiles: forehead and both cheeks, divided by black eye sockets with upswept tails, black brows edged with white, and a black nose socket. A thin vertical stripe at the centre of the forehead. Just under ONE eye only - the eye on the RIGHT side of the picture - a small round red dot ringed with a thin white circle: the mark of the eye he lost to an arrow. Nothing dripping, no blood. Fierce, staunch.

MUZHA.name: Muzha, a celestial warrior (a silver god face)
MUZHA.pattern: ground of silver (painted as pale cool grey-white metallic pigment with a soft sheen, slightly tarnished) in three tiles: forehead and both cheeks. Black upward-slanting eye sockets, long black brows, a black nose socket, and a small red flame-shaped mark at the centre of the forehead. Calm, otherworldly. Silver-grey and black, one red mark.

MONKEY.name: Sun Wukong, the Monkey King (the monkey face, hou lian: the inverted-peach type)
MONKEY.pattern: a large solid vermilion-red inverted peach (heart) shape fills the middle of the face: its two rounded upper lobes ring both eyes and meet in a small downward notch above the nose bridge; below that it narrows into a stem that runs down the nose and around the mouth to a point at the chin. Inside each lobe a large oval eye patch filled with gold-ochre (the fiery golden eyes), separated from the red by a thin white line, the eye itself small and bright in the middle of the gold; short black curved brows drawn inside the top of each gold patch. At the bottom of the red, a small black monkey nose with two nostrils, and a narrow beak-like black mouth line. Outside the peach the face is white: across the forehead, down the sides of the face and on the chin; along the cheeks, temples and jaw fine short black curved strokes of monkey fur fanning outward, a little pale yellow at the temples near the ears. On the forehead a small black cloud curl at the centre (no writing, no symbol, no character). Lively, quick, mischievous. Red, gold, white and black only.
